description: Assesses the appropriate security controls based on data sensitivity, service type, compliance requirements, and threat landscape.

recommendation.pattern: Defence in Depth with Enhanced Monitoring
recommendation.rationale: Systems handling SECRET or TOP SECRET data require multiple layers of security controls including encryption at rest and in transit, network isolation, intrusion detection, security information and event management (SIEM), and regular penetration testing. The security posture must be continuously monitored and validated.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires dedicated security operations centre (SOC) or managed security service; security-cleared personnel
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: 24/7 security monitoring, regular penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, key rotation, and security posture reviews

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Significant; SOC staffing or managed service, SIEM licensing, security tooling, and regular assessments
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Security architecture design; tool procurement; SOC establishment; accreditation process

recommendation.pattern: OWASP-Aligned Application Security with Data Protection
recommendation.rationale: Public-facing services handling PII require application-level security controls aligned with OWASP Top 10, combined with data protection measures including encryption, pseudonymisation where appropriate, and data minimisation. Regular security testing and vulnerability management are essential.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires security champion within development team; periodic security review from specialist
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Dependency vulnerability patching, WAF rule updates, security testing in CI/CD, and data protection impact assessments

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Security tooling licensing; WAF costs; periodic penetration testing
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Security assessment; remediation of existing vulnerabilities; tooling integration

recommendation.pattern: Cloud Security Posture Management with Encryption
recommendation.rationale: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE workloads in cloud require continuous security posture management to detect misconfigurations, combined with encryption at rest and in transit. Cloud-native security services provide automated compliance checking and drift detection.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires cloud security knowledge; can be managed by development team with security guidance
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Security finding remediation, policy updates, compliance reporting, and periodic security reviews

costConsiderations.runningCosts: CSPM service costs; audit log storage; alerting infrastructure
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Security baseline configuration; policy development; initial remediation

recommendation.pattern: Enhanced Data Protection with Privacy Controls
recommendation.rationale: Systems processing special category data (health, biometric, ethnic origin, etc.) require enhanced privacy controls including data protection impact assessments, purpose limitation enforcement, consent management, and the ability to fulfil data subject rights (access, erasure, portability).

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires Data Protection Officer involvement; privacy engineering skills needed
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: DPIA reviews, consent record management, DSAR processing, data retention enforcement, and privacy audit

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Privacy tooling licensing; DPO time allocation; DSAR processing costs
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: DPIA completion; privacy engineering implementation; consent mechanism development

recommendation.rationale: Without cloud access, security controls must be implemented using on-premises tooling including firewalls, intrusion detection systems, endpoint protection, and a SIEM for log aggregation and threat detection.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Requires dedicated security operations team; SIEM management is resource-intensive
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: SIEM rule tuning, vulnerability remediation, endpoint agent updates, and security incident response

costConsiderations.runningCosts: SIEM licensing (often per-GB ingested); security tooling; staffing
costConsiderations.transitionCosts: Tool procurement; deployment; log source integration; team training

defaultRecommendation.rationale: When no specific conditions strongly favour an alternative, implementing a cloud-native security baseline provides foundational protection. This includes encryption at rest and in transit, security group configuration, audit logging, and basic vulnerability scanning using cloud-native services.

operationalBurden.staffingImplications: Development team can manage with security guidance
operationalBurden.ongoingMaintenance: Security finding remediation and periodic reviews

costConsiderations.runningCosts: Low; cloud-native security services often included or low-cost

commonQuestions: What is the data classification and what security controls does it mandate?
Is there an existing security operations capability?
What are the regulatory compliance requirements?
Does the system process PII or special category data?
What is the threat model for this service?
Are there existing security tooling investments to leverage?
